# Source: Still Life—Strawberries, Nuts, &c.

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Still Life—Strawberries, Nuts, &c.
- **Artist / culture:** Raphaelle Peale (American, 1774–1825)
- **Date:** 1822
- **Style:** Realism
- **Classification:** painting
- **Department:** Arts of the Americas
- **AIC artwork ID:** 120154
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/120154
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/1cddae1c-99d5-462f-4aa6-128c0732ac11/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Symbolism

## Extracted source palette

`#181818, #382818, #685838, #484838, #581808, #886848, #784808, #887868`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#0C0C0C`
- `surface`: `#282828`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#784808`
- `on_primary`: `#F8F8F6`
- `secondary`: `#581808`
- `surface_variant`: `#282828`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#4E4E4E`
- `error`: `#784808`
- `on_error`: `#F8F8F6`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `18.4:1`, surface `13.86:1`
- Variant contrast: `13.86:1`
- Control contrast: `7.24:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
